description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'NamespacedEntityIdWithType' that extends 'EntityIdWithType' and implements 'NamespacedEntityId'. It provides functionality for handling namespaced entity IDs, including methods for retrieving namespace and name, checking compatibility with other entity IDs, and overriding equality and hash code methods.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdWithType
classes.description: An abstract class representing a namespaced entity ID that is aware of its entity type, providing methods for namespace and name retrieval, compatibility checks, and equality.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the entity ID by delegating to the contained 'namespacedEntityId'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity ID by delegating to the contained 'namespacedEntityId'.

methods.name: isCompatibleOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if another entity ID is compatible with this one, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: isNamespaceAndNameCompatible
methods.description: Determines if the namespace and name of another entity ID are compatible with this one.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equality method to compare entity ID objects based on contained ID and entity type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides the default hash code method to generate a hash based on super class, contained ID, and entity type.
